edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient of newly minted tokens
_count controls the mint loop bound and token quantity
mint calls _safeMint for each requested token
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract, giving it control flow back into mint
mint forwards excess ETH to an untrusted address via low-level call before finishing
Refund call target is the caller-controlled msg.sender
price is computed from _count multiplied by NFT_PRICE
NFT_PRICE is a multiplier in the price calculation
remaining is computed by subtracting price from msg.value
remaining amount is the value sent in the low-level refund call
calcStartingIndex writes the startingIndex state variable
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock
setBaseURI writes the _baseTokenURI state variable
baseURI_ parameter is stored into the contract state
_baseURI returns _baseTokenURI for tokenURI computation
_owner parameter is queried in walletOfOwner
tokenCount is assigned from balanceOf(_owner)
num parameter controls the reserveTokens loop bound
supply is assigned from totalSupply() in reserveTokens
reserveTokens calls _safeMint to create reserved tokens
reserveTokens may set startingIndexBlock if unset
val parameter is written into the paused state variable
pause updates the paused flag
balance is assigned from address(this).balance in withdrawAll
withdrawAll transfers the captured balance to the owner
Withdrawal transfers ETH to msg.sender without reentrancy protection

emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is guarded by onlyOwner using msg.sender

normalization_plan.reason: _count is a transient function parameter only meaningful within mint
num is a transient function parameter only meaningful within reserveTokens
baseURI_ is a transient function parameter only meaningful within setBaseURI
val is a transient function parameter only meaningful within pause
_owner is a transient function parameter only meaningful within walletOfOwner
price is a local computation inside mint used to derive the refund
remaining value flows directly into the low-level refund call
supply is a local snapshot of totalSupply used within reserveTokens
balance is a local snapshot used to size the withdrawal transfer
tokenCount is a local loop bound computed inside walletOfOwner
